The '''Daltarri system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Truum sector/Legends|Truum sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daltarri]].
